mapper.select: /*BtchExeTxnDAO.listBtchBas 배치기본 조회 */ SELECT BTCH_JOB_ID /* 배치작업ID */ ,BTCH_JOB_NM /* 배치작업명 */ ,BTCH_CYCL_CD /* 배치주기코드 */ ,BTCH_EXE_PGM_NM /* 배치실행프로그램명 */ ,BTCH_EXE_PRMT /* 배치실행파라미터 */ ,RE_EXE_POSBL_YN /* 재실행가능여부 */ ,BTCH_EXE_DESIG_DD /* 배치실행지정일 */ ,BTCH_JOB_TTM /* 배치작업시간 */ ,CRON_EXRS /* CRON표현 */ ,AUTO_EXE_YN /* 자동실행여부 */ ,DESC_CTNT /* 설명내용 */ FROM BTCH_BAS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND IFNULL(APLY_START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')) <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') AND IFNULL(APLY_END_DT, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')) >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d')

/*BtchExeTxnDAO.selectBtchBas 배치기본 상세 조회 */ SELECT BTCH_JOB_ID /* 배치작업ID */ ,BTCH_JOB_NM /* 배치작업명 */ ,BTCH_CYCL_CD /* 배치주기코드 */ ,BTCH_EXE_PGM_NM /* 배치실행프로그램명 */ ,BTCH_EXE_PRMT /* 배치실행파라미터 */ ,RE_EXE_POSBL_YN /* 재실행가능여부 */ ,BTCH_JOB_TTM /* 배치작업시간 */ ,CRON_EXRS /* CRON표현 */ ,AUTO_EXE_YN /* 자동실행여부 */ ,DESC_CTNT /* 설명내용 */ FROM BTCH_BAS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND BTCH_JOB_ID = #{btchJobId}

/*BtchExeTxnDAO.listBtchExeTxn 배치실행내역 조회 */ SELECT BTCH_EXE_SEQNO /*배치실행일련번호*/ ,BTCH_JOB_ID /*배치작업ID*/ ,BTCH_PRMT_VAL /*배치파라미터값*/ ,USER_ID /*사용자아이디*/ ,TAGET_TRT_CSCNT /*대상처리건수*/ ,BTCH_EXE_STUS_CD /*배치실행상태코드*/ ,BTCH_START_DTM /*배치시작일시*/ ,BTCH_FIN_DTM /*배치완료일시*/ ,SUCSS_YN /*성공여부*/ ,BTCH_ERR_CTNT /*배치오류내용*/ FROM BTCH_EXE_TXN WHERE 1=1 AND BTCH_JOB_ID = #{btchJobId} AND BTCH_START_DTM BETWEEN (SUBSTR(#{btchStartDtm},1,8)||'000000') AND (SUBSTR(#{btchStartDtm},1,8)|| '240000') AND BTCH_START_DTM >= #{btchStartDtm}
mapper.insert: /*BtchExeTxnDAO.insertBtchExeTxn 배치실행내역 저장 */ INSERT INTO BTCH_EXE_TXN ( BTCH_JOB_ID /*배치작업ID*/ ,BTCH_PRMT_VAL /*배치파라미터값*/ ,USER_ID /*사용자아이디*/ ,TAGET_TRT_CSCNT /*대상처리건수*/ ,BTCH_EXE_STUS_CD /*배치실행상태코드*/ ,BTCH_START_DTM /*배치시작일시*/ ,SUCSS_YN /*성공여부*/ ,BTCH_ERR_CTNT /*배치오류내용*/ ) VALUES ( #{btchJobId} /*배치작업ID*/ ,#{btchPrmtVal} /*배치파라미터값*/ ,#{userId} /*사용자아이디*/ ,#{tagetTrtCscnt} /*대상처리건수*/ ,#{btchExeStusCd} /*배치실행상태코드*/ ,DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') /*배치시작일시*/ ,#{sucssYn} /*성공여부*/ ,#{btchErrCtnt} /*배치오류내용*/ )
mapper.update: /*BtchExeTxnDAO.updateBtchExeTxn 배치실행내역 수정 */ UPDATE BTCH_EXE_TXN SET BTCH_PRMT_VAL = #{btchPrmtVal} /*배치파라미터값*/ ,TAGET_TRT_CSCNT = #{tagetTrtCscnt} /*대상처리건수*/ ,BTCH_EXE_STUS_CD = #{btchExeStusCd} /*배치실행상태코드*/ ,BTCH_FIN_DTM = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') /*배치완료일시*/ ,SUCSS_YN = #{sucssYn} /*성공여부*/ ,BTCH_ERR_CTNT = #{btchErrCtnt} /*배치오류내용*/ WHERE BTCH_EXE_SEQNO = #{btchExeSeqno} /*배치실행일련번호*/ AND BTCH_JOB_ID = #{btchJobId} /*배치작업ID*/
